# pangolin_orgs (Data Source)

Lists every organization visible to the calling API key. Useful for multi-org admin workflows and audit reporting.

> **Note:** root-only — fails with HTTP 403 when the provider's API key is not server-admin scoped. The `ssh_ca_private_key` attribute carries the org's SSH CA private key in clear; treat it as a credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_orgs" "all" {}

# Multi-org admin summary.
output "org_summary" {
  value = [
    for o in data.pangolin_orgs.all.orgs : {
      id     = o.org_id
      name   = o.name
      subnet = o.subnet
    }
  ]
}

# Filter to orgs with audit log retention configured.
output "orgs_with_audit" {
  value = [
    for o in data.pangolin_orgs.all.orgs : o.org_id
    if o.settings_log_retention_days_request > 0
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `orgs` (Attributes List) List of organizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--orgs))

<a id="nestedatt--orgs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `orgs`

Read-Only:

- `billing_org_id` (String) The billing org reference. Null in self-host.
- `created_at` (String) ISO-8601 timestamp of when the organization was created.
- `is_billing_org` (Boolean) Whether this org carries the billing account. Null in self-host.
- `max_session_length_hours` (Number) Maximum session length in hours. Null when inheriting.
- `name` (String) Display name of the organization.
- `org_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `password_expiry_days` (Number) Password expiry policy in days. Null when inheriting.
- `require_two_factor` (Boolean) Whether 2FA is required for users. Null when the org inherits the default.
- `settings_log_retention_days_access` (Number) Access audit log retention in days. 0 means disabled.
- `settings_log_retention_days_action` (Number) Action audit log retention in days. 0 means disabled.
- `settings_log_retention_days_connection` (Number) Connection audit log retention in days. 0 means disabled.
- `settings_log_retention_days_request` (Number) Request audit log retention in days. 0 means disabled.
- `ssh_ca_private_key` (String, Sensitive) The org's SSH CA private key. Treat as a credential.
- `ssh_ca_public_key` (String) The org's SSH CA public key.
- `subnet` (String) The org's primary subnet (e.g. `100.90.128.0/24`).
- `utility_subnet` (String) The org's utility subnet.
